_comment: Copy to config.json and paste the token from @BotFather. chat_id fills itself in once you send /register in the group.
_usage_poll_comment: Where the limits come from on most setups: Claude Code only renders the status line in its terminal UI, so a VSCode-only install gets nothing from it. The daemon asks /api/oauth/usage itself, with the CLI's own token from ~/.claude/.credentials.json. It is the only part of the bridge that touches a credential; set enabled to false to stop it.
_spawn_comment: Runs `claude -p` for a project with no live session. Remote code execution driven by a chat message — leave it off unless you mean it.
